description: Read a range (A1 notation, e.g. "Ledger!A1:F200") of a spreadsheet. Numbers come back as numbers and dates as formatted text; at most 10000 cells, and a range open at the bottom ("A:F", "Ledger!$A:$F") or longer than the cap is cut to the rows that fit, with truncated=true when more may remain: read further down with a range that starts after the last row. A bare name without quotes ("Expenses") is passed to Google as written, since it may be a named range, so name a tab as "Ledger!A:F" or "'My Tab'" to have it bounded. Free. Use when the user asks about data held in one of their connected spreadsheets.

appId.description: Product id; optional when the workspace has one product.

id.description: Spreadsheet id from sheets_create or sheets_list.

name: sheets_read
title: Read Spreadsheet Range
